value.text: The Orion E4 supports a maximum AC input of 11 kW using three-phase 400 V, 16 A per phase through a Type 2 connection. A wallbox advertised at 22 kW does not raise the E4 above 11 kW, as the onboard charger accepts no more than the vehicle rating. The GridNest W11 can charge up to a configured maximum of 11 kW, subject to site configuration. Therefore, neither the Orion E4 nor the GridNest W11 can charge at 22 kW.
